title: OLD BUG : Activate/Deactivate pod buttons are lit
symptom: Both pod activate and deactivate buttons are turned ON (lit, not grayed) all the time, regardless of whether a pod is activated or not.
cause: The bug was introduced by styling changes in a recent build, as previously it was caused by styling changes. The issue was resolved in a later build.
fix: Update to the latest dev build (e.g., commit 49af54) which works again.
